faqCategories.categoryName: VoIP, Call Routing, and Front Desk Workflow

questions.question: How does VoiceStack integrate with our existing phone numbers and hardware?

children.text: You can keep all your existing numbers. Porting is quick and easy, and VoiceStack runs smoothly on desk phones, mobile devices, and computers.

questions.question: What is an IVR, and how can it be used for multi-location practices?

children.text: An IVR is a guided phone menu that directs patients to the correct department or location. It simplifies routing for practices with multiple clinics.

questions.question: How do we track and manage missed calls or dropped calls in the IVR?

children.text: A real-time dashboard alerts you to missed or abandoned calls, including the exact point at which the call dropped, and automatically creates follow-up tasks.

questions.question: Can team members answer calls remotely on VoiceStack?

children.text: Yes. The platform fully supports remote agents through both our desktop app and mobile app.

questions.question: What analytics do we gain from call flows and routing?

children.text: You can view routing paths, bottlenecks, drop points, answer performance, call-handling time, and workflow-efficiency metrics.

questions.question: How quickly can we implement VoiceStack?

children.text: Most practices complete implementation within 3-4 days. Larger multi-location groups may take slightly longer depending on routing complexity.

questions.question: How does an AI receptionist handle new patient calls and appointment scheduling?

children.text: It greets callers, identifies the reason for the call, answers common questions, and guides the patient to booking or rescheduling. When needed, it hands the call to a live team member.

questions.question: Can the AI receptionist work after hours and during peak call times to ensure no calls are missed?

children.text: Yes. It operates around the clock and handles overflow during busy hours, so every patient reaches help without waiting.

questions.question: Will the AI recognise specialty-specific terms and questions?

children.text: Yes. It is trained to accurately recognise specialty-specific terms, coverage questions, urgent needs, and everyday enquiries.

questions.question: How does the AI determine when to route a call to a live person?

children.text: VoiceStack assesses the caller's intent, urgency, and complexity. If human assistance is needed, the AI transfers the call immediately.

questions.question: Can the AI make outbound calls for recalls or follow-ups?

children.text: Yes. It can initiate hygiene recalls, treatment follow-ups, reminders, and other routine outbound tasks.

questions.question: What happens if a caller's question is outside the AI's programming?

children.text: The AI hands the call off to a team member and summarises the context so the team can respond appropriately.

questions.question: Can we customise the AI's tone?

children.text: Yes. You can adjust voice style, greeting messages, and the entire call experience to match your practice.

faqCategories.categoryName: Call Tracking, Analytics, and Marketing Attribution

questions.question: Does VoiceStack support features such as dynamic number insertion, keyword-level tracking, call recording, and tagging?

children.text: Yes. VoiceStack includes dynamic number insertion, keyword-level tracking, call recording, and tagging. Each visitor from a campaign gets a unique number so you can see exactly which ads or keywords drove the patient.

questions.question: Does VoiceStack integrate directly with Google Ads?

children.text: Yes. VoiceStack integrates with Google Ads and can send conversion events directly, helping improve and optimise your Google Ads performance.

questions.question: Can we monitor which keywords or campaigns lead to booked appointments?

children.text: Yes. VoiceStack links call outcome data with campaign sources and keyword data so you can see which ones convert.

questions.question: How can call transcripts, conversation summaries, and scoring help improve front practice performance?

children.text: Transcripts reveal missed opportunities and patient intent. Conversation summaries give a quick snapshot of past interactions, and scorecards support effective coaching.

questions.question: How fast does the dashboard refresh with new call data and AI insights?

children.text: Updates are reflected in real time, allowing you to track call activity and team performance instantly.

questions.question: What metrics should we track in VoiceStack?

children.text: Key metrics include answer rate, missed call response rate, conversion rate, call source, call outcomes and reasons, team performance, and marketing attribution.

questions.question: How does VoiceStack identify and surface potential revenue opportunities?

children.text: VoiceStack flags any call where the purpose is appointment booking, but the outcome is not booked. These are grouped into a Potential Opportunity bucket, making it easy to identify and convert high-value calls.

questions.question: Does VoiceStack integrate with major practice management systems?

children.text: Yes. It works with leading practice management and business systems across multiple specialties.

questions.question: Can call data and transcripts sync with our CRM or marketing platforms?

children.text: Yes. You can automate tasks, track conversions, and push call outcomes directly into your CRM and marketing dashboards.

questions.question: Will VoiceStack support practices operating in multiple locations or different time zones?

children.text: Yes. It is designed for single-practice and multi-location groups, with location-specific routing and time zone handling.

questions.question: How secure is the integration with PMS and CRM platforms?

children.text: All integrations adhere to strict healthcare security standards and are fully HIPAA-compliant. Data is stored, transmitted, and accessed through secure, encrypted systems to protect patient information at every step.

questions.question: Does VoiceStack integrate with major CRMs?

children.text: Yes, VoiceStack integrates with leading CRMs, including HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Twenty.com, and more.

questions.question: What is the expected return on investment when using VoiceStack?

children.text: Practices see ROI through more answered calls, higher new-patient conversion rates, better marketing attribution, reduced team stress, and improved operational efficiency.

questions.question: Is patient data stored securely and handled safely?

children.text: Yes. All call recordings, transcripts, and analytics are stored with strict privacy controls, secure encryption, and complete HIPAA compliance.

questions.question: What kind of training and ongoing support does VoiceStack provide?

children.text: We provide comprehensive pre-go-live training, including videos and documentation. After going live, you receive two hours of dedicated training plus on-demand sessions as needed. Our team offers ongoing assistance from 8.00 AM to 7.00 PM EST.

questions.question: Are there additional costs we should be aware of?

children.text: Pricing is transparent. DNI numbers and the VoiceBot feature are available as optional add-ons, and there are no unexpected costs beyond what you choose.
